report.summary: 4 items: fix drift accepted-island suppression (high), validate mint 'wrote' key (high), harden worktree path leak (critical), check prefix regex & dry-run default (medium).
risks: Item 4 (freshness-prefix) depends on locating _ABBREV_SHA_RE definition; file not confirmed in repo.
Item 2 assumes mint.py contains mint_task_from_landed_edit; if not, need to find correct file.
Item 1 assumes drift.py contains the logic described; verified by cited source.
Item 3 assumes worktree.py contains _is_linked_worktree; needs verification.
todos: Locate _ABBREV_SHA_RE definition (likely in daedalus/spine/ or daedalus/kairos/)
Write and run tests for each item

items.title: Fix accepted island suppression in drift.py
items.why_now: Confirmed bug: accepted islands are misclassified as NEW_ISLAND, suppressing legitimate drift findings. Blocks accurate mapping.

steps.do: In drift.py, modify the logic that computes known_unreached to exclude modules with acceptance records (i.e., those in old_islands with an acceptance key) so they are not treated as unreached.
Add unit test that creates a snapshot with an accepted island and verifies it is not suppressed in BECAME ISLAND category.

items.assumption: The cited source lines 1302-1325 are accurate and the bug is reproducible.

items.title: Add validation of report['wrote'] in mint_task_from_landed_edit
items.why_now: High severity: missing type/schema validation makes the function fragile to changes in offload.py output.

steps.do: In mint.py, add explicit validation that report['wrote'] is a list of strings (or expected type) before processing; raise or log if invalid.
Write test that passes malformed 'wrote' (e.g., None, dict) and expects graceful failure.

items.assumption: mint_task_from_landed_edit exists in daedalus/eval/mint.py; if not, locate correct file.

items.title: Harden worktree path leak with graceful failure on missing worktree
items.why_now: Critical: if _is_linked_worktree fails, minting stores an absolute path that becomes unresolvable; can cause crashes.

steps.do: In worktree.py, add a fallback in mint_from_diffs that catches unresolvable paths (e.g., worktree deleted) and returns None or logs warning instead of raising.
Write test that creates linked worktree, mints, deletes worktree, and verifies resolve_task_repo returns None.

items.assumption: _is_linked_worktree and mint_from_diffs exist in daedalus/kairos/worktree.py; test may need git operations.

items.title: Verify and fix freshness prefix collision (regex minimum length)
items.why_now: Medium: if _ABBREV_SHA_RE allows fewer than 7 hex chars, prefix matching can cause false freshness; docstring warns of risk.

steps.do: Print the regex pattern for _ABBREV_SHA_RE and check minimum length; if <7, update regex to require at least 7 hex characters.
steps.verified_by: Print regex and run test with recorded='a' and actual='abcdef1' to verify startswith does not pass.

steps.do: Write test that verifies short recorded values do not cause false match.

items.assumption: The file containing _ABBREV_SHA_RE is not known; likely in daedalus/spine/ or daedalus/kairos/. Need to locate first.

items.title: Confirm dry-run default enforcement in picker.py main()
items.why_now: Medium: if main() does not enforce dry-run as default, operators may inadvertently trigger actions.

steps.do: Grep for 'def main' in daedalus/spine/picker.py and check if it enforces dry-run (e.g., no --apply flag, default action is dry-run).
steps.verified_by: Output of grep shows logic; run python -m daedalus.spine.picker --help to confirm no --apply flag.

steps.do: If dry-run not enforced, add argparse default action='store_true' for --dry-run and set default to True.
steps.verified_by: python -m daedalus.spine.picker --help shows dry-run default; run without args and verify no side effects.

items.assumption: The grep will find main() and we can inspect its argument parser.
